main_text.p: à Cathulle, filius domini de Ryhoven à Gent. Lancearia primum instituitur decursio, verum cum nihil eà proficeretur, gladiis certatur; ac tandem eques Albanus manu truncatus, & superatus, suae temeritatis dedit poenas. Cui exemplo haud dissimile alterum duellum initum inter Thomam Albanum centurionem, & optionem turmae equitum D.Norwits,qui in locum sui praefecti,certis legibus se stitit. Certatum igitur in conspectu utriusque exercitus, lanceis ac gladiis, obsidibus Idem Histor. libr. 10. fol. mihi. 191. utrinque datis. Quinimo satis diu pugnatum fuit aequo marte, illaeso utroque, donec tandem secundum leges certamini praescriptas dirempti, poculo invicem propinato, discesserint.
Ad quod certaminis genus an merito referatur conflictus

page.notes: The marginal note in the left margin is printed in small type; it is "Idem Hi-" / "ftor. libr." / "10.fol." / "mihi." / "191." and is transcribed with the long s written as s. The word "nihil" has a small ink blot over its first letter, read as "nihil". The word "Lancearia" is printed with a final character that is hard to read and may be "a". The catchword "prope" is printed alone at the right below the last line. Faint marks at the bottom right corner are a digitiser's watermark and were not transcribed.
